notes.title: Version 0.4.0.0 (Game Access 2025 Demo)
notes.notes:
A small demo prepared for Game Access 2025 taking place in Brno

Contains:

the first official level Blood and snow

the original pre-alpha demo level Forest troubles

a secret level you can open by finding two relics

Notes:

VFX, SFX and character models will be changed and improved in very near future
